keyword: fine stone or aggregate distance row on the order

title.en: Which Distance Row to Write on a Xingtai Pump Order
title.zh: 邢台泵的订单上该写哪一行距离

description.en: Several Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages in Xingtai print more than one distance pair. The order has to name the row: fine stone, aggregate 13, 13 mm or 24 mm. A single unmarked “distance” is not a row.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的多张页面印有不止一组距离。订单必须点明行：细石、13 骨料、13 mm 或 24 mm。没有行名的“距离”不是一行。

h1.en: Name the Distance Row Before You Ask for a Quote

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints split distance rows on Electric 30, Electric 40, Electric 50, Electric 60, Electric Low Pressure 60 and the diesel mixer. Electric 30’s fine-stone pair is 60 m / 180 m and its aggregate-13 pair is 20 m / 60 m. Electric 40’s pairs are 120 m / 360 m and 40 m / 120 m. Writing only “360 m” does not say which row you buy against. Send the row name with the measured metres to the contact page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）在电动30、电动40、电动50、电动60、电动低压60和柴油搅拌泵上印了分行距离。电动30的细石是 60 m / 180 m，13 骨料是 20 m / 60 m。电动40是 120 m / 360 m 和 40 m / 120 m。只写“360 m”并没有说明你对照的是哪一行。把行名和量到的米数一起发到询盘页。

heading.zh: 有三种石子标题的页面

body.en: Electric 50, Electric 60, Electric Low Pressure 60 and the diesel mixer print fine stone (or ≤ 1 inch on the diesel mixer), then 13 mm, then 24 mm. Each label has its own pair. Electric 60’s fine-stone pair is 200 m / 600 m; its 24 mm pair is 100 m / 300 m.
body.zh: 电动50、电动60、电动低压60和柴油搅拌泵印有细石（柴油搅拌泵写 ≤ 1 英寸），然后是 13 mm，然后是 24 mm。每个标题有自己的一组。电动60的细石是 200 m / 600 m；24 mm 是 100 m / 300 m。

body.en: Electric 20 prints one pair, 120 m / 40 m. Diesel 30 prints one pair, 60 m / 180 m. Electric 80 prints one pair, 900 m / 300 m. Do not invent a second row for those sheets.
body.zh: 电动20只有一组 120 m / 40 m。柴油30只有一组 60 m / 180 m。电动80只有一组 900 m / 300 m。不要给这些表编第二行。

heading.en: Horizontal and vertical stay in the printed order
heading.zh: 水平和垂直保持页面上的顺序

body.en: Where the label says H / V, the first number is horizontal. HBT80-16 does not use that pair style: it prints horizontal conveying 120 m and delivery height 360 m as separate labels. Copy the label, not a private abbreviation. Inquire at [/en/contact/](/en/contact/).
body.zh: 标题写 H / V 时，第一个数是水平。HBT80-16 不用这种成对写法：它把水平输送 120 m 和输送高度 360 m 分成两个标题。抄标题，不要自造缩写。询盘见 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。

question.en: Can I add the fine-stone metres to the aggregate metres?
question.zh: 可以把细石米数和骨料米数相加吗？

answer.en: No. They are alternative rows on the same sheet, not two segments of one pipeline.
answer.zh: 不能。它们是同一张表上的备选行，不是一条管路的两段。

question.en: What if my stone is between two labels?
question.zh: 石子粒径落在两个标题之间怎么办？

answer.en: Send the measured maximum size and the row you think is closest. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai matches the printed label. Do not create a midpoint distance.
answer.zh: 发送量到的最大粒径和你认为最接近的行。河北品锦机械（邢台）对照已印标题。不要自造一个中间距离。

question.en: Does Electric Low Pressure 40 have two rows?

answer.en: The sheet used here prints one fine-stone pair, 80 m / 240 m.
answer.zh: 此处使用的表只印一组细石 80 m / 240 m。

question.en: Is the price different per row on the website?
question.zh: 网站上每一行的价格不同吗？

answer.en: No prices are printed. Name the row so Xingtai can quote the page you mean.
answer.zh: 没有印价格。写明行名，邢台才能对你指的页面报价。
